<?php
function peerShift225() { global $late, $owner; $late = 99; $owner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerStaticBase225 {
    public static function capture($saved, $marker) {
        echo 'CAPTURE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return $saved;
    }
}
class PeerStaticChild225 extends PeerStaticBase225 {}
class PeerMagicBase225 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $kept; $kept = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
class PeerMagicChild225 extends PeerMagicBase225 {}
$owner = new PeerMagicChild225;
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$result = $owner->MiSsInG(first: false, later: (
    \Closure::fromCallable(['PeerStaticChild225', 'capture'])
)($late, peerShift225()));
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
